messages:
sara: Hey team — Heads up: Idex procurement just asked for a formal pricing exception. They want a 2yr committed Dedicated plan with ISO27001 in contract and asked if we can do 35% off list. They also require a SOW + PO before kickoff. Can we move on this?

mike: Who's the technical lead on their side? Any infra or custom integration asks?

sara: Contact is Priya (procurement) and their SRE lead is on the thread. Tech ask is normal — private VPC + on-prem connector for logging. No custom model work.

ellie: Legal note: ISO27001 clause + data handling appendix are fine but need a standard addendum. We'll need SOC2/ISO evidence link before countersign. Also, 35% off is outside our commercial playbook for Dedicated unless there's a big ARR/commit or strategic case.

dan: Pricing floor check — our list for Dedicated is $0.40/token-equivalent for their expected profile. For a 2yr commit, the standard approach is a staged discount: up to 20% approved by RevOps for under $250k ARR TCV. Anything >20% needs headcount/sales leadership sign-off. Can you confirm expected TCV?

sara: Estimated TCV ~ $420k over 24 months (includes onboarding credit + 2 dedicated pools). They asked for immediate 35% bump to get procurement sign-off.

oscar: Quick ops note: Dedicated with VPC + on-prem connector triggers Professional Services packaging — estimate $40k one-time. We should include that in TCV.

mike: From SE POV, no extra engineering concessions required beyond standard onboarding. Good to flag PS charge.

procurement-bot: FYI — Please open DEAL-4892 in deal-desk and attach ISO evidence and initial SOW.

sara: Created DEAL-4892 and added Priya's email + SOW draft. Requesting RevOps review for discount.

dan: I'll review. Given $420k TCV + $40k PS, total ~ $460k. For that band we can stretch to 25% if we add contra: a 30-day onboarding milestone tied to payment and PO, and a non-refundable initial commit. 35% still requires CRO approval.

ellie: Legal OK to draft ISO addendum and PO terms if RevOps approves commercial. Also suggest adding a clause: customer must provide ISO evidence within 10 business days of countersign or we reserve right to revert pricing.

sara: If we propose 25% + $40k PS + $30k onboarding credit (invoice upfront), would that get procurement to move quickly?

d an: small typo? Dan's name should be consistent.

dan: yes, 25% + PS + $30k onboarding prepaid looks approvable from my side. I'll queue for CRO approval for the extra 10% (to reach 35%) but don't expect it to clear without an exec rationale.

oscar: Ops can accept the 30-day milestone and initial prepaid. Will also include a dedicated runbook deliverable.

mike: I'll prepare a short technical appendix for the SOW to speed legal review.

sara: I'll propose the 25% offer to Priya today with the proposed contract milestones and note that 35% is escalated but pending exec sign-off. Will also include link to our SOC2 and ISO evidence.

ellie: Sounds good. Add this language for the ISO evidence clause: "Customer shall provide ISO/attestation evidence within 10 business days of countersign. Failure to provide will allow Provider to revert to standard rates."

dan: Marking DEAL-4892 as "Pricing: RevOps-approved (25%) — Escalation to CRO for +10%". I'll write the justification in the ticket (strategic customer, mid-market expansion, timeline risk).

sara: Priya replied: "25% looks better — can you send final SOW + PO terms ASAP? Procurement needs the onboarding milestone spelled out."

procurement-bot: DEAL-4892 status updated: awaiting CRO response for additional discount.

sara: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll attach SOW v1 and the SE appendix. Will close loop when PO arrives.
